limitations: Only the VAS1/VAS2 before-and-after pairs of Table 2 are kept as series. The other Table 2 columns (age at diagnosis, disease duration, duration of tocilizumab use, previous treatments, adverse effects) are single descriptors, not serial measurements, and Table 3 holds series-level medians, so those cells are not used.
The VAS1/VAS2 meaning (before/after tocilizumab) comes from the Table 2 footnote; the scale and unit are not stated.
